A CANDIDATE VESSEL COULD BE SEEN VERY CLOSE TO THE STARTING POINT OF THE ANOMALY FOR POSSIBLE BILGE DUMP OR SPILL BUT THE ANOMALY DOESN’T APPEARED TO BE CONNECTED TO THE VESSEL. THE WINDS NEAR THE TIME OF THE IMAGE WERE OUT OF THE SW AROUND 10 KTS. UNCERTAINTIES: THE SOURCE OF THE ANOMALY IS STILL UNCERTAIN BUT A CANDIDATE VESSEL CAN BE SEEN VERY CLOSE TO THE ANOMALY

Report Description
***NESDIS MARINE POLLUTION REPORT*** AREA OF POSSIBLE OIL IS SEEN JUST SOUTH OF THE U.S. EEZ TAKEN ON 3/29 AND EXTENDS FOR APPROXIMATELY 42 MILES IN LENGTH WHILE BEING 0.3-0.4 MILES WIDE. NO POINT SOURCE IS SEEN IN THE IMAGE BUT BASED ON THE FADED APPEARANCE FURTHER SOUTHEAST AND SHARPER APPEARANCE FURTHER NORTHWEST, IT IS BELIEVED THE RESPONSIBLE PARTY WAS MOVING NORTHWEST TOWARDS U.S. WATERS. FEATHERING OF THE OIL IS SEEN ALONG THE LENGTH AND AGREES WITH WIND DATA SHOWING 10-15 KT EASTERLY WINDS NEAR THIS LOCATION. A SMALL ANOMALY NORTH OF THE U.S. EEZ IS THOUGHT TO BE OIL FROM A NEARBY NATURAL SEEP. UNCERTAINTIES: WHILE NO POINT SOURCE IS ASSOCIATED WITH THIS ANOMALY, ALL OTHER FACTORS POINT TO HIGHER CONFIDENCE THAT THE AREA ANALYZED IS AN OIL SLICK, LIKELY FROM A SHIP MOVING TO THE NORTHWEST TOWARDS U.S. WATERS. NO POINT SOURCE LIMITS CONFIDENCE TO MEDIUM-HIGH THOUGH. FEATHERING IS OBSERVED IN THE IMAGE ON THE EAST SIDE OF THE SLICK, CORRELATING TO MODERATE WINDS OUT OF THE EAST, AND ALSO INCREASING CONFIDENCE.

Nearest City: Earl, AR
Incident Type: UNKNOWN SHEEN
Material: OIL: DIESEL
Medium Affected: WATER
Suspected Responsible Party: TRAVELCENTERS OF AMERICA
Skytruth Analysis
THE SPILL WAS INITIALLY IDENTIFIED AT APPROXIMATELY 8:00 AM AND WAS LOCATED BETWEEN THE FACILITY STORE AND DIESEL DISPENSER #1; THE ORIGIN OF THE SPILL IS UNKNOWN. AT APPROXIMATELY 9:30 AM, JIM’S TANK SERVICE, LLC (JIM’S TANK SERVICE) IDENTIFIED DIESEL FUEL IN A DITCH NEAR THE SITE. JIM’S TANK SERVICE SKIMMED FUEL FROM THE DITCH AND PLACED ABSORBENT BOOMS ACROSS THE DITCH TO PREVENT FURTHER MIGRATION OF DIESEL FUEL. AT APPROXIMATELY 11:15 AM, TA LEFT VERBAL NOTIFICATION OF THE SPILL ON ARKANSAS DEPARTMENT OF ENVIRONMENTAL QUALITY’S ANSWER SERVICE. AT 1:15 PM, TA DISCUSSED THE DETAILS OF THE SPILL AND CLEANUP RESPONSE WITH THE ADEQ. TA WAS NOTIFIED AT APPROXIMATELY 4:50 PM THAT THE A SHEEN WAS OBSERVED ON SHELL LAKE, WEST OF THE SITE. JIM'S TANK SERVICE IS IN THE PROCESS OF SETTING BOOMS NEAR THE DISCHARGE OF THE DITCH TO SHELL LAKE.

REPORT DATE: 09-23-2026 REPORT TIME: 1203 UTC REGION: GULF OF AMERICA SUB REGION: N/A AREA/BLOCK: MAIN PASS 80 IMAGE DATE: 09-22-2026 IMAGE TIME: 1737 UTC DATA SOURCE: PLANETSCOPE MODE: MULTISPECTRAL RESOLUTION: 3 METER LOCATION: 29°14'24" N/89°03'04" W AREA: 0.45 SQUARE KILOMETERS CONFIDENCE: HIGH REPORT MAP/GIS FILES: HTTPS://WWW.OSPO.NOAA.GOV/PRODUCTS/OCEAN/MARINEPOLLUTION/ REMARKS: POSSIBLE OIL WAS OBSERVED IN SATELLITE IMAGERY. THIS ANOMALY IS UNCONFIRMED AS OIL. THE ANOMALY WAS IN THE MAIN PASS AREA OF LOUISIANA, 2 NM OFFSHORE JUST NORTH OF NORTH PASS. POSSIBLE OIL WAS DARK AGAINST THE BACKGROUND AND UNLIKE NATURAL SIGNATURES IN THE AREA. THERE WERE TWO MAIN STREAMS, EACH APPROXIMATELY 2 NM LONG, THIN, ORIENTED NORTH-SOUTH. MULTIPLE FACILITIES SURROUNDED THE NORTHERNMOST END OF THE WESTERN STREAM, AND ONE FACILITY SPECIFICALLY WAS SITUATED AT THE NORTHERN TIP OF THE EASTERN STREAM. Report Description
***WEB REPORT*** LEAK DEVELOPED IN A 4" STEEL SALT WATER DISPOSAL PIPELINE AT A DISTANCE OF APPROX. 9,550' EAST OF THE DRILL SITE KNOWN AS THE JENSEN 2-29A5 LOCATED IN DUCHESNE COUNTY, UTAH.
